hook.name: EqtInrUsdtTreasuryHook
hook.description: Intercepts EQT→USDT swaps on BNB Chain and redirects the entire EQT input amount to a configurable treasury address via poolManager.take(). Targets the EQT/USDT pair only; other pools are ignored. An owner-controlled pause mechanism exists in storage but the enforcement check is commented out and non-functional.
